# HarborOS support

For configuration and usage help, [open a question](https://github.com/HarborNAS/community/issues/new?template=question.yml) or use [Community Q&A](https://github.com/HarborNAS/community/discussions/categories/q-a).

For bugs, [submit a bug report](https://github.com/HarborNAS/community/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). For improvements, [submit a feature request](https://github.com/HarborNAS/community/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).

See the [community guide](../README.md) for submission instructions. English and Chinese are welcome. These are public channels; remove sensitive information from attachments.
